Message.MsgText: File Transfer Function Component accepts only a IBM Security Verify Directory Integrator Entry as input.

Explanation.p: At the beginning of the Function Component's execution cycle the input data passed was not a IBM Security Verify Directory Integrator Entry.

OperatorResponse.p: File Transfer Function Component expects only a IBM Security Verify Directory Integrator Entry as input. Check the AL logic and try again.

An invalid connection type has been specified. The valid values for the 'connectionType' parameter are: 'RSH', 'SSH', 'REXEC', 'AS400', 'WIN' and 'FTP'.

Message.MsgText: File Transfer Function Component could not establish a connection to the target machine using given parameters in Configuration Editor. File Transfer Function Component will continue, if any attribute mapping provided in runtime.

Explanation.p: This exception occures because there might be invlid connection parameters provided in Configuration Editor either in Source or Target section.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the connection parameters are valid and that the network connection to the target is active and then try again the connection.

Message.MsgText: Specified target directory 'param name' does not exist.

Explanation.p: Target directory path should exists on the target machine.

OperatorResponse.p: Please specify a different Target directory or select 'Create Directory' check-box in configuration panel.
